question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a green ball, Bob has a black ball, Claire has a teal ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a orange ball, Fred has a grey ball, and Gertrude has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Dave swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Fred and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Finally, Bob and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Eve has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) black ball
(C) teal ball
(D) white ball
(E) orange ball
(F) grey ball
(G) gold ball
solution:
Ball colors in holder order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (green, black, teal, white, orange, grey, gold)
1. Alice ↔ Dave: (white, black, teal, green, orange, grey, gold)
2. Claire ↔ Alice: (teal, black, white, green, orange, grey, gold)
3. Dave ↔ Gertrude: (teal, black, white, gold, orange, grey, green)
4. Fred ↔ Claire: (teal, black, grey, gold, orange, white, green)
5. Dave ↔ Bob: (teal, gold, grey, black, orange, white, green)
6. Eve ↔ Dave: (teal, gold, grey, orange, black, white, green)
7. Bob ↔ Eve: (teal, black, grey, orange, gold, white, green)
Eve has the gold ball, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
